result.finding: Microservices Architecture with Layered Internal Structure
evidence: CustomersServiceApplication.java is annotated with @SpringBootApplication and @EnableDiscoveryClient indicating a standalone deployable microservice
pom.xml includes spring-cloud-starter-netflix-eureka-client for service discovery registration
pom.xml includes spring-cloud-starter-config for centralized configuration (Config Server pattern)
Service name 'customers-service' and package structure (customers.*) indicate this is one of multiple microservices in the Spring PetClinic microservices project
Internal code follows Layered Architecture: web (controllers), model (entities/repositories), config (cross-cutting)
